description: Curated addiction and dependency risk profiles based on publicly available pharmacology data.

profiles.explanation: Oxycodone is a potent opioid with high abuse potential. Physical dependence develops with regular use.
warnings: High risk of addiction, abuse, and misuse
Physical dependence develops with prolonged use

profiles.explanation: Hydrocodone is a widely prescribed opioid with significant abuse potential.
warnings: High potential for abuse and addiction

profiles.explanation: Alprazolam has rapid onset and short duration, making it one of the most addictive benzodiazepines.
warnings: One of the most commonly abused benzodiazepines
Withdrawal can cause seizures — requires medical supervision

profiles.explanation: Diazepam has longer duration than alprazolam, but physical dependence still develops with regular use.
warnings: Dangerous in combination with alcohol or opioids

profiles.explanation: Tramadol can cause dependence and withdrawal. Also has SNRI-like properties.
warnings: Can cause physical dependence despite lower schedule
Risk of seizures at higher doses

profiles.explanation: Gabapentin has emerging evidence of misuse, particularly in combination with opioids.
warnings: Increasing reports of misuse, especially with opioids
Taper when discontinuing to avoid withdrawal
